status.nb: 55 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 28 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Manila, Philippine og Malaca.

summary.en: China's coast guard continues to monitor Philippine resupply missions to the grounded warship at the disputed shoal and has shadowed a U.S. warship nearby, while Chinese warships and a research vessel were sighted near Bajo de Masinloc. The Philippines is expanding cooperation with Taiwan to protect undersea cables, and Taiwan has expressed openness to joint cable-protection efforts. An ex-NSA urged activation of the Philippines-China coast guard agreement, and the Philippine coast guard rescued four people on Hagonoy Island. Coast Guard personnel were killed and another wounded in a Cotabato City shooting. 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kystvakten i Kina fortsetter å overvåke filippinske påfyllingsoppdrag til det grunnstøtte krigsskipet ved den omstridte sandbanke og har fulgt et amerikansk krigsskip i nærheten, mens kinesiske krigsskip og et forskningsfartøy ble observert nær Bajo de Masinloc. Filippinene utvider samarbeidet med Taiwan for å beskytte undersjøiske kabler, og Taiwan har uttrykt vilje til felles kabelbeskyttelsesinnsats. En tidligere NSA oppfordret til aktivering av kystvaktsavtalen mellom Filippinene og Kina, og den filippinske kystvakten reddet fire personer på Hagonoy-øya. Kystvaktspersonell ble drept og en annen såret i en skyting i Cotabato City. 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
